name: Mark Chesnut
note: 1981 Talisman p.234 read directly (leaf n237, archive.org): a Men's Intramurals results table, no photograph on the page. Names a 'Mark Chestnut' (Sigma Alpha Epsilon) twice as an intramural event winner, badminton singles and racquetball doubles with Mitch Gum. The yearbook's own index gives 'Chesnut, Mark Cameron 234' for this page, so the table's spelling is probably the yearbook's typo, but nothing on the page ties the intramural winner to the ASG treasurer term and the two are not established here as the same person. The index page reference was real but does not lead to a portrait.

name: Debbie Thomas
note: Zero hits in the local Herald full index. The 1981 Talisman index (archive.org) lists two candidates: "Thomas, Deborah Lynn 356" and a second "Thomas, Debra Ann" with no page number, so the name alone does not pick one. Opened printed page 356 (leaf n359 of talisman1981west, via scripts/talisman.py) on 9 November: it is the Juniors class-directory grid, and the block of names beside the matching photo row reads "DEBORAH L. THOMAS, Glasgow / GREGORY S. THOMAS, Columbia / JAMES A. THOMASON, Morgantown / ...", nine names against nine thumbnails, with Deborah L. Thomas first and leftmost. The years.json note on the Complaint and Suggestion committee chair gives only "Debbie Thomas, named 2 September 1980" - no hometown, class or middle name - so there is nothing to confirm this Glasgow junior is the same Debbie Thomas against the unlocated Debra Ann Thomas, and surname-plus-first-name alone is exactly the match CLAUDE.md rules out. Left unconfirmed, not added to photos.json. A future pass with a hometown, major or middle initial from the SGA minutes could settle it. UPDATE, 10 November 2026: that source is no longer out of reach - digitalcommons.wku.edu/cgi/viewcontent.cgi opened this session via python's urllib (curl still 403s; see .research/photo-run-2026-11-10-scheduled.md). Fetched the actual SGA minutes of 2 September 1980 (sga/Meetings/Minutes/260, viewcontent article=1639, 335 KB, 2 pages, real text layer). They name the committee chairmanship - "Complaint and Suggestion - Debbie Thomas" in Fuller's list of standing committees and chairs - but carry no middle name, hometown, major or any other biographical detail, on either page. The disambiguating fact this entry has been waiting for is not in this document. Left unconfirmed, as before; do not refetch 1639 expecting more - it has now been read in full and has nothing further to give.
